task_objective: Verify the v0.4.6 fail-safe autosync work on a live Steam Deck from plugin logs, then cut and publish the v0.4.6 stable patch release.
tdd_note: No behavior-changing implementation code was written. Release notes, README cache buster, and version metadata only, so strict TDD did not apply.

findings: Clean launch (local save current): SIGSTOP launch gate held 3.5s and released after the skip decision.
Conflict launch: gate held 17.0s spanning the conflict prompt and user-chosen restore, released only after the restore completed, confirming start-side mutations run under the backend-owned gate.
Status auto-hide now schedules at 210000ms, matching the three-minute operation cap plus margin; the previous value was 930000ms.
Post-game exit to SYNCTHING COMPLETE took 19.4s, consistent with the 18.4s baseline from v0.4.4.
No watchdog absolute resume, lease expiry, command timeout, or operation_running contention occurred.
The only ERROR lines were nine decky_loader WSRouter task teardowns during the install reload, which originate in Decky rather than this plugin.
untested_paths: The three-minute give-up path and the retained-gate fallback when a stuck command cannot be confirmed stopped were not exercised on hardware.

design_decisions: Released as v0.4.6 rather than bumping further: the repository already carried 0.4.6 and the latest stable tag was v0.4.5, so v0.4.6 is the next patch.
Release notes were authored in the user-facing voice required by CLAUDE.md section 13, stating the paused-launch fallback and the untested give-up path plainly rather than omitting them.
The README demo cache buster was incremented from 8 to 9 so the image refreshes for the new tag.
The session log was committed to dev rather than main to avoid re-diverging main immediately after the post-release sync.

results.quality_gates: ruff check, ruff format, ty check, 1041 pytest tests, 366 vitest tests, tsc, and pnpm supply-chain audits all passed.
results.workflow: Build and Release Plugin run 32287656571 succeeded in 1m29s.
results.post_release_sync: main merged into dev and dev bumped to 0.4.7 (fd61f27).
